use: Offline evidence for the reviewed claims nlm-fleischner-solid-table-cross-check and nlm-fleischner-subsolid-table-cross-check. scripts/audit-fleischner-primary-source.mjs uses it only when the live NLM table page is a recognised bot-challenge page; every other live failure still fails closed.

authorization.scope: Keep an independently compared copy of NLM Tables 5.1 and 5.2 as the evidence and make the live check recognise the challenge. Clinical claims, test vectors and fail-closed checks are unchanged.

attribution.chapter: Abbott GF, Vlahos I. CT Diagnosis and Management of Focal Lung Disease. In: Hodler J, Kubik-Huch RA, von Schulthess GK, editors. Diseases of the Chest, Breast, Heart and Vessels 2019-2022: Diagnostic and Interventional Imaging. Cham (CH): Springer; 2019. p. 47-55.
attribution.tables_credit: MacMahon H, Naidich DP, Goo JM, et al. Radiology 2017;284(1):228-243. DOI 10.1148/radiol.2017161659
attribution.changes: Only cell text is kept. Markup, captions and credit lines are removed; cell line breaks become spaces; dashes, comparison signs and whitespace are normalized by extractHtmlLiteralText in scripts/audit-fleischner-primary-source.mjs.

cells.note: The PDF text layer extracts the printed '<' as ',' ('remains, 6 mm'); the printed RSNA cell reads 'remains <6 mm', as NLM does.

second_retrieval_path.channel: NLM Bookshelf open-access subset bulk package (not served through the challenged web page)
second_retrieval_path.method: Take the <table> element of table-wrap ch5.Tab1 and ch5.Tab2, normalize it with extractHtmlLiteralText, and SHA-256 the UTF-8 text.
second_retrieval_path.result: Both normalized texts equal the pinned cells joined in document order and reproduce the reviewed locator_text_sha256 values of docs/evidence/fleischner-2017-reviewed-evidence.json exactly.

primary_publication.citation: MacMahon H, Naidich DP, Goo JM, et al. Guidelines for Management of Incidental Pulmonary Nodules Detected on CT Images: From the Fleischner Society 2017. Radiology 2017;284(1):228-243.
primary_publication.method: Map every NLM recommendation cell to its Table 1A or 1B cell in the text layer of the hash-pinned version-of-record PDF. The audit re-checks each mapping on every run.
primary_publication.result: All 18 NLM recommendation cells agree with Table 1: 13 identical, 4 equivalent wording and 1 identical apart from a PDF text-layer glyph. No interval, size category or optional-versus-required qualifier differs.
